description: This file defines data structures and an interface related to lease management, including classes for representing lease acquisition results, lease requests, and the lease provider interface itself. It is part of the Orleans distributed framework's lease provider subsystem.

classes.name: AcquiredLease
classes.description: Represents an acquired lease with resource key, duration, token, and start time.

classes.name: AcquireLeaseResult
classes.description: Holds the result of a lease acquire or renew operation, including the lease, status, and failure exception.

classes.name: ResponseCode
classes.description: Enumerates possible response statuses from lease operations, such as success, failure, or lease unavailability.

classes.name: LeaseRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a lease request with resource key and desired duration.

classes.name: ILeaseProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods for batch lease operations: acquire, renew, and release.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously batch acquire leases for a category based on provided lease requests.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Asynchronously batch renew existing leases for a category.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Asynchronously batch release specified leases for a category.
